_about: The 60 gold questions for the BinaSmart telecom pack (knowledge/telecom, source `telecom`): 25 Amharic questions answered by an Amharic page, 20 English questions answered by an English page and 15 Amharic questions whose answer is on an English page (the ECA laws and Safaricom, which has no Amharic site). Every question names the document under knowledge/telecom/ that answers it. `topic` is the English subject the page must discuss and `topicAm` the Amharic one for a page that is itself in Amharic; ops/packs/build-gold.js refuses to write the gold file unless three of a topic's content words are in that page. `alsoSlugs` names a second document that carries the same answer (Directive 832/2021 and the ECA consumer-affairs page repeat each other), verified the same way. Written on 2026-09-22 from the fetched pages, never from memory; every figure in a question was read on its page first.
